_comment: Every U.S. Code section the catalog cites, as 'N USC sec' or as an Internal Revenue Code 'IRC §sec' / 'IRC sec' (title 26), with its heading as read on law.cornell.edu (LII) on 2026-10-17; uscode.house.gov was in a temporary format and returned no section pages that day. test/unit/usc-citations-verified.test.js fails on a citation not listed here. The building code is also abbreviated IRC; its sections start with R and are not matched. 12 USC 1454 was added on 2026-11-26 and read that day on law.cornell.edu AND on the GPO 2023 edition (govinfo.gov, USCODE-2023-title12-chap11A-sec1454); the two agree on the catchline verbatim, and both carry the §(a)(2) sentence "The foregoing limitations may be increased by not to exceed 50 per centum" for properties in Alaska, Guam, Hawaii, and the Virgin Islands. uscode.house.gov returned 404 for the section on both prelim granule URLs.
